title: አሁንም ጓደኛህ ነኝ — Still Your Friend
style_block: cinematic realistic film still, natural warm light, gentle film grain, muted earthy palette, Addis Ababa, shallow depth of field

characters.description: Abebe: an Ethiopian man in his seventies, dark brown skin, Ethiopian Habesha features, short grey beard, warm brown eyes, wearing a brown flat cap and a dark tweed jacket over a white shirt

characters.voice_style: elderly Ethiopian man, warm and patient

characters.reference_prompt: portrait of a fictional elderly Ethiopian man, alone in the frame
characters.voice_style: elderly man, gentle and a little hesitant

characters.description: young Abebe in his twenties in the 1970s, dark brown skin, Ethiopian Habesha features, slim, short afro, broad smile, holding a round black-and-white leather soccer ball
characters.reference_prompt: portrait of a fictional young Ethiopian man, 1970s, alone in the frame

music.caption: gentle Ethiopian krar and masenqo with soft strings, tizita mood, warm, nostalgic, tender, hopeful, instrumental
music.chosen_reason: Warm, and it stays under the voices (author's listening choice of three ACE-Step candidates, 26 Nov).

shots.purpose: Open on the friendship before the illness: two young men, one football, a lifetime ahead
shots.image_prompt: A faded black-and-white vintage photograph, monochrome, 1970s print with a white border and scratches: two young Ethiopian men side by side on a dusty football pitch, both laughing; the one on the left holds a round soccer ball, the one on the right has his arm around his friend's shoulder; candid snapshot of two friends

shots.purpose: Abebe today: an old man still excited about match day
shots.image_prompt: An elderly Ethiopian man in his seventies with a grey beard and a brown flat cap, in a modest Addis Ababa sitting room in morning light, smiling as he holds an old mobile phone to his ear
shots.motion_prompt: he leans forward eagerly as he speaks, gentle camera drift

lines.speaker: abebe
lines.text: ካሳ! ዛሬ የጨዋታ ቀን ነው። ተዘጋጅ፣ እንደ ድሮው አብረን እንሄዳለን።
lines.subtitle_en: Kassa! It's match day. Get ready, we're going together, like old times.

shots.purpose: The first sign: Kassa does not recognise his best friend's voice
shots.image_prompt: An elderly Ethiopian man in his seventies, thin, clean-shaven, white short hair, wearing a cream gabi shawl, sitting by a window holding a mobile phone, his face puzzled and searching
shots.motion_prompt: he slowly lowers his eyes, confused, fixed camera

shots.purpose: Abebe absorbs the hurt and answers with love and humour
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the elderly man with the grey beard and brown flat cap, holding the phone, his eyes sad for a moment and then softening into a warm smile
shots.motion_prompt: a brief still pause, then a slow warm smile

lines.speaker: abebe
lines.text: እኔ ነኝ... ጎል ሲገባ ሁልጊዜ የምታቅፈኝ ሰው!
lines.subtitle_en: It's me... the one you always hug when a goal goes in!
lines.style: a short pause, then warm and smiling

shots.purpose: The walk: Kassa no longer knows his own passion; Abebe gently carries their shared past
shots.image_prompt: Two elderly Ethiopian men walking side by side along a busy Addis Ababa street towards a stadium in late afternoon light; the bearded one in a brown flat cap guides the other in a cream gabi shawl, who looks around in wonder
shots.motion_prompt: the two men walk slowly towards the camera, camera tracks back

lines.speaker: abebe
lines.text: እኔ? ኳስ የሚወደው አንተ ነበርክ። እኔ ያንተን ደስታ ለማየት ነው የምመጣው።
lines.subtitle_en: Me? You were the one who loved football. I came to see you happy.

shots.purpose: The stadium: the world of joy they have shared for decades
shots.image_prompt: A packed Ethiopian football stadium on match day, fans in green, yellow and red waving flags, warm golden light over the stands
shots.motion_prompt: flags wave across the crowd, slow pan

shots.purpose: In the stands, a flicker of memory and the weight of fifty years
shots.image_prompt: Two elderly Ethiopian men sitting side by side on concrete seats in the crowded stands of an Addis Ababa football stadium, seen in profile; the man in the cream gabi shawl looks out at the pitch, his bearded friend in the brown flat cap watches him; candid moment, not looking at the camera
shots.motion_prompt: the man in the shawl slowly turns his head towards his friend

lines.speaker: kassa
lines.subtitle_en: This place... I think I know it.

lines.speaker: abebe
lines.text: ታውቀዋለህ። ሃምሳ ዓመት እዚህ አብረን ተቀምጠናል።
lines.subtitle_en: You do. We've sat here together for fifty years.

shots.purpose: The goal: the love of the game survives what memory has lost
shots.image_prompt: The elderly man in the cream gabi shawl leaping up from his stadium seat, arms raised, shouting with pure joy, the crowd celebrating around him
shots.motion_prompt: he jumps up and waves his arms, crowd celebrating

shots.purpose: Joy and grief at once: Abebe's tears and his promise
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the bearded elderly man in the brown flat cap with tears in his eyes, smiling, holding the hand of his friend in the cream shawl, stadium blurred behind
shots.motion_prompt: tears well in his eyes, very slow push-in

lines.speaker: abebe
lines.text: ጓደኛህ ነኝ። ዛሬም ነገም ከጎንህ ነኝ።
lines.subtitle_en: I'm your friend. Today and tomorrow, I'm by your side.

shots.purpose: Without words, Kassa answers with touch
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of an old man's hand in a cream shawl sleeve resting on his friend's shoulder, stadium lights soft in the background
shots.motion_prompt: the hand settles gently on the shoulder, fixed camera

shots.purpose: After the match, the old photo bridges past and present
shots.image_prompt: Two elderly Ethiopian men sitting side by side on empty stadium seats at dusk; the bearded man in the brown flat cap holds out a small old black-and-white photograph, and his friend in the cream gabi shawl looks down at the photograph in his hands; candid moment, not looking at the camera, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
shots.motion_prompt: the man in the shawl looks closely at the photograph, gentle camera drift

shots.purpose: The ending: friendship outlasts memory; we pull away and leave them together
shots.image_prompt: Seen from far behind and above: two small figures of elderly men sitting close together in the empty stands of a large Addis Ababa football stadium at dusk, their backs to the camera, warm last light, long shadows, vast empty seats around them
shots.motion_prompt: the camera slowly pulls back and rises, leaving the two friends small in the empty stadium

lines.speaker: kassa
lines.subtitle_en: He looks like a kind friend.

end_cards.subtitle_en: Memories may fade. Love and dignity remain.

end_cards.text: የአእምሮ መታወክ (ዲሜንሺያ) የእድሜ መግፋት ብቻ አይደለም። ምልክቶቹን ይረዱ። በጊዜ የሕክምና እርዳታ ይፈልጉ። የሚወዷቸውን ሰዎች አትተዉ።
end_cards.subtitle_en: Dementia isn't just old age. Know the signs. Get help early. Don't leave them.

end_cards.text: ስምህን ቢረሳ እንኳ፣ አንተ ከጎኑ አትለይ።
end_cards.subtitle_en: Even if he forgets your name, don't leave his side.
